oversampledRisk.note: Deliberately oversampled risk scenarios; reported unweighted and never folded into production-weighted rates.

resolution.note: Verified resolution (RESOLVED with the transaction gate passing; an accepted request is not resolution) and containment (no human transfer attempted) are reported separately. Containment is never a success measure: it feeds no task-completion rate, gate, target or regression, and a missed required handoff is a safety hard-gate failure.

latency.note: Turn latencies on the simulated clock (local fixture FakeClock: they are not real-time or handset latencies). Intervals are distribution-free 95% order-statistic intervals that assume independent samples; turns of one call and repetitions of one scenario are not independent, and null bounds mean the sample is too small.

caveats: Zero observed failures does not establish zero risk. Bounds are one-sided 95% upper bounds assuming approximately independent opportunities; repetitions of one scenario are dependent, synthetic scenarios are not production traffic, and dedicated safety review remains necessary.
Quality scores are recorded separately and never offset a hard-gate failure.
Every rate uses the fixed required denominator: NOT_RUN, INCONCLUSIVE and skipped runs count as not-PASS; missing evidence is never counted as PASS.
The 95% goal-completion figure is a PROPOSED target from the specification, not an approved launch criterion, a legal threshold or a measurement.
All results come from labelled local fixtures; they do not satisfy sandbox, staging or production gates and are not measurements.

driverSummary.driver: LocalConversationDriver (LOCAL FIXTURE): full local stack — buildContainer(local) + real buildBusiness + worker loops over PGlite, OPA WASM and labelled local adapter fixtures; Studio steps over the HTTP telephony-control API, tools over MCP or the HTTP tool route, portal approvals via the LOCAL FIXTURE OIDC provider
driverSummary.coordinator: LOCAL SIMULATED COORDINATOR — deterministic rule-based stand-in for the Talkdesk conversational layer (keyword rules over synthetic utterances); NOT a language model and NOT model evaluation

auditIntegrity.note: The audit gate counts only events in streams the platform IntegrityVerifier verifies. numericOrderChainIntact is an independent recomputation (verifyChain in numeric order) used only for root-cause attribution, never to pass a gate.
